mapper.select: SELECT item_id, watchlist_id, instrument_id, display_order, added_at, alert_price, alert_direction, alert_status, alert_triggered_at, alert_triggered_price FROM Watchlist_Items WHERE item_id = #{itemId}

SELECT item_id, watchlist_id, instrument_id, display_order, added_at, alert_price, alert_direction, alert_status, alert_triggered_at, alert_triggered_price FROM Watchlist_Items WHERE watchlist_id = #{watchlistId} ORDER BY display_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Watchlist_Items (item_id, watchlist_id, instrument_id, display_order, added_at) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{watchlistId}, #{instrumentId}, #{displayOrder}, #{addedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT item_id, watchlist_id, instrument_id, display_order, added_at, alert_price, alert_direction, alert_status, alert_triggered_at, alert_triggered_price FROM Watchlist_Items WHERE watchlist_id = #{watchlistId} AND instrument_id = #{instrumentId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM Watchlist_Items WHERE watchlist_id = #{watchlistId} AND instrument_id = #{instrumentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE Watchlist_Items SET alert_price = #{alertPrice}, alert_direction = #{alertDirection}, alert_status = 'ACTIVE', alert_armed_at = clock_timestamp(), alert_triggered_at = NULL, alert_triggered_price = NULL WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
UPDATE Watchlist_Items SET alert_status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND alert_status IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT wi.item_id, w.user_id, i.ticker, i.name, wi.alert_price, wi.alert_direction, wi.alert_armed_at FROM Watchlist_Items wi JOIN Watchlist w ON w.watchlist_id = wi.watchlist_id JOIN Instruments i ON i.instrument_id = wi.instrument_id WHERE i.ticker = #{symbol} AND wi.alert_status = 'ACTIVE'
